consequence.statement: If an AlertmanagerConfig v1alpha1 object sets an Opsgenie responder type that is not escalation, schedule, team, teams or user, the API server would reject it under the new schema enum.
consequence.remediation: Change every Opsgenie responder type to one of escalation, schedule, team, teams or user before you upgrade the CRDs.

assertion.statement: The AlertmanagerConfig v1alpha1 schema field spec.receivers[].opsgenieConfigs[].responders[].type now has an allowed-values list (escalation, schedule, team, teams, user), where no enum values were listed before.
